company.name: Alga Biosciences
company.shortDescription: Alga Biosciences is a startup that develops solutions to reduce methane emissions from cattle farming using algae-based feed additives.
company.description: Alga Biosciences is a feed additive intended to eliminate agricultural methane emissions by cattle using algae. They use biochemistry to eliminate enteric methane emissions and provide natural red seaweed and feed additives, enabling farmers to save money and the community to fight against climate change and slow global warming.

productsAndServices.description: A feed additive for cattle that reduces methane emissions by up to 97% while lowering feed requirements for growth.
productsAndServices.name: Alga Feed Supplement

aiResearchSummary.text: Ruminant Feed Supplement Formulations and Methods for Reducing Enteric Methane describes novel compositions and feeding methods that lower enteric methane emissions in ruminants. The abstract details animal feed supplements designed to reduce methane output when incorporated into ruminant diets. Together, the title and abstract show work on feed additive formulations and nutritional strategies for reducing enteric methane emissions and mitigating ruminant greenhouse gas output.
